definitions.explanation: A weather term used in Japan for days when the maximum temperature reaches 35°C (95°F) or higher.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{猛暑日|もうしょび}になる{予報|よほう}だ。
examples.english: The forecast says today will be an extremely hot day.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}の{夏|なつ}は{猛暑日|もうしょび}が{多|おお}かった。
examples.english: This summer had many extremely hot days.

examples.japanese: {猛暑日|もうしょび}は{熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう}に{注意|ちゅうい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: On extremely hot days, you need to be careful of heatstroke.

notes:
{猛暑日|もうしょび} is an official Japan Meteorological Agency term.

TEMPERATURE SCALE IN JAPAN:
- {夏日|なつび}: over 25°C
- {真夏日|まなつび}: over 30°C
- {猛暑日|もうしょび}: over 35°C
- {酷暑日|こくしょび}: over 40°C (newer term)

USAGE NOTE:
{猛暑日|もうしょび} is frequently used in weather forecasts and news during summer. Often paired with warnings about {熱中症|ねっちゅうしょう} (heatstroke).
